caption: The drawing consists of five distinct objects depicted on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is a round, slightly domed object colored in tones of yellowish-brown with some greenish shading and darker lines indicating depth and contours; it has a small, circular indented center. Below this, at the left and right sides, there are two cup-shaped objects with a narrow stem and a wider upper section; these objects are similarly rendered in yellowish-brown with some darker and greenish accents, and the tops are open. At the bottom left and bottom right of the composition, there are two shallow, dish-shaped objects, each also colored in yellowish-brown with greenish details and shading; both have a central raised circular element, one of which appears to have a small projecting cylindrical form. The objects are symmetrically arranged, with the round domed piece above, the two cup-shaped objects below it and slightly apart, and the two dish-shaped items at the bottom, aligned with the cups. The background is plain with no additional elements or features.
title: Candlestick
